title: Group8_Homework2
text:
Two vectors are created corresponding to the pre-treatment and post-treatment measurements for twenty subjects.

# Create the pre-treatment blood pressure vector
pretreatment <- c(130, 128, 116, 124, 133, 134, 118, 126, 114, 127, 141, 138, 128, 140, 137, 131, 120, 128, 139, 135)

# Create the post-treatment blood pressure vector
posttreatment <- c(114, 98, 113, 99, 107, 116, 113, 111, 119, 117, 101, 119, 130, 122, 106, 106, 124, 102, 117, 113)




Subject numbers are assigned using the paste() function to the pre-treatment and post-treatment vectors.

#Assign subject names to pre-treatment vector
names(pretreatment) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")

#Assign subject names to post-treatment vector
names(posttreatment) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")




Calculated the change in blood pressure (pretreatment - posttreatment) and saved the calculation as a new vector.

bp_diff <- pretreatment - posttreatment




Calculated the average decrease in blood pressure across all subjects.

mean(bp_diff)

[1] 17





Determined a list of subjects that experienced a decrease in blood pressure (bp_diff>0) with treatment.

which(bp_diff>0)

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
         1          2          3          4          5          6          7 
 Subject_8 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_14 Subject_15 Subject_16 
         8         10         11         12         14         15         16 
Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        18         19         20 





Subset the vector of differences to only return those that have a positive change.

positive_diff <- bp_diff[bp_diff>0]




Calculated the average decrease in blood pressure for those subjects that had a positive change

mean(positive_diff)

[1] 20.64706
